Kubernetes MCP server: host-side install instructions in the PR body (binary is installed on the Windows host, not part of the sandbox image)
prBodyNotes: This update only changes the default of `local-scripts/install-kubernetes-mcp-server.ps1`; the binary is installed on the Windows host.
1. Switch the kit checkout locally to this PR's branch (the new default only exists there until merge):
2. Stop the running server (Windows locks the `.exe`): `Get-Process kubernetes-mcp-server -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process`
5. Restart the sandbox/session so the sbx MCP gateway spawns the new binary, then `git switch master`.
Alternative without switching branches: run the script on `master` with `-Version v{{{newValue}}}`.

packageRules.description: Docker MCP server (fork dboeckli/mcp-server-docker): host-side re-registration instructions in the PR body (runs on the Windows host via uvx, not part of the sandbox image)
prBodyNotes: This pin only changes the documented/registered version; the server runs on the Windows host via `uvx`.
1. Re-register the server on the host (PowerShell):
2. Running sandboxes: `sbx mcp load docker --sandbox <name>` (or recreate the sandbox).
3. Verify: `sbx mcp ls` / `sbx mcp inspect docker` shows the fork pin `...mcp-server-docker@v{{{newValue}}}`.
`uvx` clones the pinned fork tag on first start; there is no local install script for this server.
